identity.fantasy: An arcane wand gunslinger who banks fragments, configures a temporary firing mode, and cashes the setup into engineered payoff shots.
identity.one_line: Build Echo Fragments with wand attacks and Discordance, then spend them on Shatter Echo, Distortion spells, or one of several mutually exclusive Continuums. The skill is choosing and sequencing the payoff, not simply pressing faster.

mechanics.core_loop: Generate Echo Fragments with Artificer's Wand, Wand of Time, and Discordance; choose whether to fire Shatter Echo or invest fragments into a Continuum; then use the active Continuum's altered wand, AoE, movement, or burst behavior to rebuild and cash out again.
mechanics.single_target: For ordinary leveling, current players describe banking four or five fragments and using Shatter Echo as the main direct payoff. Paradox Cannon can refill fragments during movement or between pulls, while Singularity Core is the sustained single-target Continuum and gains a stronger Shatter interaction at level 50 through Pulse Driver.
mechanics.aoe: Flux Emitter turns wand attacks into cleave and gains more targets from later talents. Arc Collision becomes a fragment-scaled Distortion option at level 50. Current leveling reports say AoE feels limited before the Flux package arrives.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Paradox Cannon generates fragments while the player moves or kites, and level-50 Aether Compression permits Artificer's Wand and Reverse Wound while moving. The spec can keep much of its engine running during movement, but direct gap creation and personal durability remain separate concerns.
mechanics.defense_and_control: The class kit supplies roots, knockback, healing, and Unstable Chronoglass for redirecting enemy casts. Borrowed Time supplies limited physical-damage recovery. Community PvP descriptions emphasize control and casting while moving more than flag-carrying or dueling strength.
mechanics.group_utility: Infinity Stone provides a non-stacking group critical-strike buff, Reverse Engineering can grant Replenishment, and the base Chronomancer kit contributes control and external haste utility depending on class-tree choices.

failure_modes.text: Spending fragments early weakens Shatter Echo or shortens the Continuum that should power the next sequence.
After level 50, missing the six-second Thread of Eternity consumption window wastes a mode-specific payoff.
Some level-50-plus players report mana pressure; a lower-cost Wand-and-Shatter fallback sacrifices parts of the full loop.

leveling_30_49.feel: By levels 30-49, generate echo fragments with artificer's wand, wand of time, and discordance; choose whether to fire shatter echo or invest fragments into a continuum; then use the active continuum's altered wand, aoe, movement, or burst behavior to rebuild and cash out again.

cautions: Choosing the wrong Continuum for the pull wastes fragments

level_50_60.feel: A more demanding sequencer. Threads of Eternity adds a six-second Discordance mark with a different consumption payoff for each Continuum, while Aether Compression, Arc Collision, Pulse Driver, and Wand Mastery broaden movement, AoE, and burst choices.
cautions: A spec-switch or spellbook bug can temporarily remove or down-rank abilities

boss.feel: On bosses, for ordinary leveling, current players describe banking four or five fragments and using shatter echo as the main direct payoff.
cautions: Current cross-spec performance evidence is not controlled

dungeon_aoe.feel: In dungeons, flux emitter turns wand attacks into cleave and gains more targets from later talents.
strengths: Cleave mode integrated with the normal wand loop

pvp.feel: In PvP, paradox cannon generates fragments while the player moves or kites, and level-50 aether compression permits artificer's wand and reverse wound while moving. The class kit supplies roots, knockback, healing, and Unstable Chronoglass for redirecting enemy casts.
cautions: Community reports do not frame it as a strong flag carrier or isolated duelist
Disruption can break a planned consumption sequence

enjoy_if.text: You enjoy builder-spender systems where order and timing matter more than raw speed.
You like selecting a temporary mode for burst, sustained damage, cleave, or movement.
You want a ranged weapon to feel central rather than cosmetic.

avoid_if.text: You dislike banking resources or losing value after spending them at the wrong moment.
You want the same low-attention loop from level 10 through level 60.
You prefer passive pets or DoTs to continue most of your damage while you react defensively.

stat_and_equipment_hooks.text: Wand weapon damage directly contributes to Artificer's Wand and Shatter Echo, so wand upgrades matter independently of caster stats.
Spirit is structurally important because Artificer's Empowerment raises it and Wand Expert converts Spirit into ranged attack power; several wand effects also scale from Spirit.
Current independent guidance prioritizes hit and penetration caps before Spirit and secondary throughput stats, but the optimization is not settled enough to publish as a definitive weight string.

praise.theme: Players describe a satisfying, understandable fragment payoff once the Continuum roles are understood.
Recent discussion recommends Artificer as a mobile ranged damage option with strong control.

frustrations.theme: Early AoE and solo kill speed can feel weak before the mode package develops.
Mana pressure is reported by some players after level 50.

contested.theme: Recent sources range from a B-tier editorial label to an A-tier community DPS aggregation; neither provides enough controlled evidence to resolve a precise rank.

gaps: No controlled level-60 rotation or stat-weight study was found.

PvP evidence is one recent recommendation thread rather than a detailed guide.

append_claims.text: A current leveling player describes building toward four or five Echo Fragments before Shatter Echo, while replies recommend Discordance into an instant Artificer's Wand and identify weak-feeling early AoE before Flux Emitter.
append_claims.notes: Small discussion, but the described sequence matches current structural talents.

append_claims.text: Current players describe Paradox Cannon as the burst, leveling, and kiting mode; Singularity Core as sustained single-target; and Flux Emitter as AoE. The current independent guide likewise describes fragment-fueled Continuum modes.
append_claims.notes: The role labels are player shorthand rather than official categories, but align with current tooltips.

append_claims.text: A current level-50-plus discussion reports mana pressure for some Artificer builds; one suggested fallback is restricting casts to Artificer's Wand and Shatter Echo, while others cite Time Out and Infinite Clone as mana tools.
append_claims.notes: The report establishes a possible pain point, not prevalence or cause.

append_claims.text: A July 25 community aggregation reports Artificer at 5,448 and places it in its A-tier band.
append_claims.notes: The post does not fully document sample size, encounter mix, gear, or normalization.

append_claims.text: A July 23 independent guide labels Artificer B-tier while describing its fragment economy and Wand-focused loop.
append_claims.notes: An editorial tier is not directly comparable to the community aggregation. The conflict is retained, not resolved.

append_claims.text: The current independent guide recommends hit and spell penetration caps, then Spirit, critical strike, haste, spell power, and Intellect for PvE, while stating that optimization is not settled.
append_claims.notes: Treat as a current proposal, not a verified weight string. Structural Spirit and wand scaling are independently supported by talents.

append_claims.text: A late-July battleground discussion recommends Artificer as a ranged option with substantial cast-while-moving access, strong control, and solid damage, while cautioning that it has limited direct mobility and is not primarily a flag carrier or isolated duelist.
append_claims.notes: Current recommendation thread, not a detailed PvP guide or controlled match analysis.

append_claims.text: Multiple current CoA players report specialization-specific or entire action-bar abilities disappearing after specialization switches; Action Bar Saver and spell-name macros are common workarounds.
append_claims.notes: A dedicated action-bar report source will be added during the known-issues pass.

append_claims.text: Current Chronomancer players report higher spell ranks sometimes returning only after opening the Book of Ascension following a specialization change.
append_claims.notes: Observed by several players but not independently reproduced in this research pass.

append_claims.text: Artificer is best described as an arcane wand gunslinger and combo sequencer because its direct weapon attacks build a resource that is spent into mutually exclusive firing modes and payoff shots.
append_claims.notes: Playstyle label, not an official category.

append_claims.text: Spending Echo Fragments before the intended Shatter or Continuum payoff creates a recoverable but material throughput loss.
Artificer's sequencing and state-tracking demands rise materially at level 50 because Threads of Eternity adds a six-second mark whose correct follow-up changes with the active Continuum.
append_claims.notes: The structural branching is certain; the degree of felt difficulty still needs broader player validation.

append_claims.text: Artificer's AoE setup loses value when targets die before Flux Emitter or Arc Collision can repay the fragment investment.
Artificer's effective PvP action and decision load is higher than its stable PvE damage loop because control, kiting, healing, and disrupted windows compete for attention.
append_claims.notes: Requires a current detailed PvP guide or verified gameplay video.
